new_packages.label: עֹל תּוֹרָה וּנְגִינָה
new_packages.reason: These four concepts all share the same essential nature in this Torah: they are all expressions of the act of bearing/accepting the holy yoke. The Rebbe establishes an explicit bechina between shoulder-carrying (כָּתֵף) and the yoke of Torah (עֹל תּוֹרָה) using the formula 'הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת.' He then extends this to song/melody via the Sages' teaching that the word for 'carrying' (ישָׂאוּ) IS the language of song (לְשׁוֹן שִׁירָה). Thus: melody (נגינה) = song/bearing (שירה) = shoulder-carrying (כתף) = yoke of Torah (עול תורה). All four are different names for the same spiritual reality: the posture of holy acceptance and bearing.

bechina_evidence.quote: שֶׁהָיוּ נוֹשְׂאִין בַּכָּתֵף אֶת הָאָרוֹן, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת עֹל תּוֹרָה
אֵין יִשָּׂאוּ אֶלָּא לְשׁוֹן שִׁירָה, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: שְׂאוּ זִמְרָה וּתְנוּ תֹף

new_packages.note: This package arises entirely from the source text, not from the dataset. It should be entered into torahData.js with two bechina edges: (1) כתף ↔ עול תורה and (2) שירה/זמרה ↔ נשיאה בכתף (or equivalently, שירה ↔ עול תורה).

observations:
Torah LM2/31 is a 60-word single-paragraph teaching. The dataset contains zero edges for reference=1031, so the analysis is driven entirely by the source text.

The Torah has a clear conceptual cluster built on the shared root שׂ-א (to carry/lift/bear): the word 'ישָׂאוּ' means both bearing on the shoulder AND singing, and this homonym is the Rebbe's structural tool for identifying melody with the yoke of Torah.

Test against the '3+ concepts connected by explicit bechina language' criterion:
- 'כָּתֵף' (shoulder) → explicit bechina of 'עֹל תּוֹרָה' via 'הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת'
- 'שִׁירָה / זִמְרָה' (song) → identified with the root שׂ-א (carry/bear) via rabbinic teaching used as bechina evidence
- 'נְגִינָה' (melody) → presented as the observable sign of the yoke of Torah, and thematically identical to שירה in this context
- 'עֹל תּוֹרָה' (yoke of Torah) → the anchor concept equated with all of the above

This meets the threshold: there are 3+ concepts joined by shared-nature identification (not cause-and-effect) forming an independent domain — the domain of 'holy bearing/accepting.'

Evil mirror: The teaching does not present an evil mirror. There is no concept of refusing the yoke, or an evil melody, or an evil carrying. The teaching is entirely in the positive domain. While one could theoretically note that 'one who has NOT accepted the yoke' is implied (the negative case), the Rebbe does not develop this into a bechina cluster. No evil package is proposed.

Conclusion: One new package is proposed — עֹל תּוֹרָה וּנְגִינָה — consisting of four nodes from the good domain, anchored on the explicit bechina equation of shoulder-carrying with the yoke of Torah, and extended through the shared root שׂ-א to include song and melody.
